g.text: N0 cold-pair qualification: neither mask qualifies
Internal CNTVCT time: all raw H/C values and signed within-trial D = C - H
64 trials per group; 3072 raw windows + 1536 paired differences. Panel y ranges differ; all tails retained.
Black bars: medians; dotted mark: P/S D median minimum 3 ticks. E is a sentinel, never subtracted. CNTFRQ = 19.2 MHz; no core-cycle conversion.
